# AMS Fulfillment

AMS Fulfillment is a Warehousing company. AMS Fulfillment provides order fulfillment services for eCommerce and wholesale B2B. They offer pick & pack fulfillment services, shipping solutions, kitting & value add services, warehouse management, inventory management, returns management, business integration, back office support, omnichannel fulfillment support, erp systems integrations, software partner integrations,. AMS Fulfillment employs 256 people (+11.8% YoY, +27 people) and has an annual revenue of $73M, founded in 2002. Headquartered in Valencia, California, United States, with offices in New Holland, Santa Clarita, Palmdale, New Castle, and Bear. Its workforce is distributed across United States and United Kingdom.

## About

YOUR BRAND. EVERYWHERE. 
eCommerce. Retail. Wholesale. Boutique. Direct to your consumer's doorstep. Fast growing brands trust AMS to deliver everywhere. 

Our brand partners focus on products, promotion and growth. We take it from there, receiving and storing your goods and creating a memorable customer experience – all while helping you lower costs and increase speed to market.

# IDS Fulfillment Powered by DHL Supply Chain

IDS Fulfillment Powered by DHL Supply Chain is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. IDS Fulfillment provides custom ecommerce fulfillment services that optimize operations, protect brand, and keep customers happy. IDS Fulfillment Powered by DHL Supply Chain employs 106 people (-5.4% YoY, -6 people) and has an annual revenue of $31M, founded in 1960. Headquartered in Plainfield, Indiana, United States, with offices in Salt Lake City and Indianapolis.

## About

At IDS Fulfillment, we build strategies that support your growth & protect your customer experience.

Our fulfillment systems are custom-designed to match how your business operates so you can scale faster, ship with confidence, and stay focused on growth.

IDS is now part of DHL Supply Chain—giving you the systems, visibility, and infrastructure to scale effectively, forecast accurately, and grow without limits.

What makes us different is the way we work with your brand. With IDS, you'll have a dedicated team that understands your day-to-day and helps build a fulfillment system that fits how you operate and where you’re headed.

At IDS Fulfillment, we combine decades of hands-on operational experience with the global strength of DHL Supply Chain to give fast-growing brands the support, technology, and infrastructure to scale with confidence.

Whether you’re managing DTC, retail, Amazon, or a multi-channel operation, we’ll help you execute every shipment with accuracy, speed, and confidence with:

- End-to-end fulfillment strategies designed around your operational needs
- Flexible infrastructure that adapts to your product mix and growth goals
- Dedicated account teams that monitor performance and optimize proactively
- Real-time inventory visibility and data integration across platforms
- Support for kitting, assembly, returns, and value-added services
- Temperature-controlled, FDA-registered, and organic-certified facilities

Whether you're shipping 500 or 50,000 orders a day, your customers expect fast delivery, accurate fulfillment, and a consistent experience. Our strategically located fulfillment centers give you full U.S. coverage, faster transit times, and seamless inventory coordination.

As part of the DHL Supply Chain network, we combine decades of experience with a team-first mindset and hands-on leadership that keeps fulfillment running smoothly. Work with a team that understands your operation and stays accountable for getting it right.

properties.description:
At IDS Fulfillment, we build strategies that support your growth & protect your customer experience.

Our fulfillment systems are custom-designed to match how your business operates so you can scale faster, ship with confidence, and stay focused on growth.

IDS is now part of DHL Supply Chain—giving you the systems, visibility, and infrastructure to scale effectively, forecast accurately, and grow without limits.

What makes us different is the way we work with your brand. With IDS, you'll have a dedicated team that understands your day-to-day and helps build a fulfillment system that fits how you operate and where you’re headed.

At IDS Fulfillment, we combine decades of hands-on operational experience with the global strength of DHL Supply Chain to give fast-growing brands the support, technology, and infrastructure to scale with confidence.

Whether you’re managing DTC, retail, Amazon, or a multi-channel operation, we’ll help you execute every shipment with accuracy, speed, and confidence with:

- End-to-end fulfillment strategies designed around your operational needs
- Flexible infrastructure that adapts to your product mix and growth goals
- Dedicated account teams that monitor performance and optimize proactively
- Real-time inventory visibility and data integration across platforms
- Support for kitting, assembly, returns, and value-added services
- Temperature-controlled, FDA-registered, and organic-certified facilities

Whether you're shipping 500 or 50,000 orders a day, your customers expect fast delivery, accurate fulfillment, and a consistent experience. Our strategically located fulfillment centers give you full U.S. coverage, faster transit times, and seamless inventory coordination.

As part of the DHL Supply Chain network, we combine decades of experience with a team-first mindset and hands-on leadership that keeps fulfillment running smoothly. Work with a team that understands your operation and stays accountable for getting it right.
